integrity: The proofs and direct exhaustive verifier are given in the package. Computational tests are finite and not an infinite proof. No independent validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple rectangular rook graphs with m,n >= 2 and inclusion-minimal connected domination only. Uses classical bipartite tree degree enumeration. Equivalent results under other names are not ruled out.
title: Minimal connected-domination spectrum of rectangular rook graphs
